blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – A University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) official defended the school’s controversial stray animal policy, saying the directive was prompted by actual safety incidents involving students and intended to protect everyone on campus. Assoc. Prof. Janette Malata-Silva, UPLB vice chancellor for student affairs, said on Friday the directive “did not arise out of nowhere.” READ: UPLB stray animal policy draws criticism “Over recent months, our office has had to directly assist students who suffered dog bites and physical accidents.
